title: Past perfect continuous, past perfect and past continuous
summary: Past perfect continuous (длительность до прошедшего момента и причина прошлого состояния) в сравнении с past perfect (результат, количество) и past continuous (действие в самый момент).
ru:
## Идея: процесс, который шёл до прошедшего момента
**Past perfect continuous** (had been + V-ing) показывает, что действие **шло некоторое время до определённого момента в прошлом** (к этому моменту оно могло закончиться, прерваться или продолжаться дальше). Само время названо через **for / since / how long** или подразумевается.
> When Anna arrived, we had been waiting for forty minutes. — Когда пришла Анна, мы ждали уже сорок минут.
> He had been living in Seoul for two years before he learned to read the signs. — Он жил в Сеуле уже два года, прежде чем научился читать вывески.
Это та же логика, что у present perfect continuous, только «сдвинутая» в прошлое.

## Объяснение причины
Чаще всего мы используем эту форму, чтобы **объяснить причину состояния или ситуации в прошлом**:
> Her hands were shaking. She had been holding the cold metal for too long. — У неё дрожали руки: она слишком долго держала холодный металл.
> The kitchen smelled of onions: somebody had been frying them. — На кухне пахло луком: его кто-то жарил.
Действие могло закончиться незадолго до этого, но его **следы** ещё видны.

## Past perfect continuous и past perfect: процесс или результат
Как и в настоящем, **continuous** подчёркивает процесс и длительность, **simple** — результат и количество.
> She had been painting the fence. — Она красила забор. (руки в краске; забор не обязательно закончен)
> She had painted the fence. — Она покрасила забор. (забор готов)
> By five he had been writing for six hours. — К пяти он писал уже шесть часов.
> By five he had written six pages. — К пяти он написал шесть страниц.
Глаголы состояния (**know, be, have, like, belong**) остаются в simple: **I had known him for years.** — ~~I had been knowing him.~~ Но с **live, work, teach, study** при for/since допустимы обе формы почти без разницы.

## Past continuous: «в тот самый момент»
**Past continuous** показывает, что действие **шло в конкретный момент** прошлого, а **past perfect continuous** — что оно началось **раньше** и тянулось **до** этого момента.
> At eight o'clock I was watching the news. — В восемь я смотрел новости. (в тот момент)
> At eight o'clock I had been working for three hours. — К восьми я работал уже три часа. (с пяти)
> When she called, I was cooking. — Когда она позвонила, я готовил. (процесс шёл)
> When she called, I had been cooking for an hour. — Когда она позвонила, я готовил уже час.

## Повторяемость и отрицание
Had been + V-ing передаёт и повторяющиеся действия: **He had been missing meetings all spring, so the board was not surprised.** В отрицательных предложениях: **I hadn't been feeling well for days when I finally called the doctor.**

## Косвенная речь
В косвенной речи present perfect continuous сдвигается в past perfect continuous: ‘I’ve been working all night,’ she said. → She said she **had been working** all night.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She was tired. She was working all night.~~ → She was tired. She **had been working** all night.
- ~~I had been knowing him for years.~~ → I **had known** him for years.
- ~~He had been reading three books by June.~~ → He **had read** three books by June.
- ~~How long were you waiting when she came?~~ → How long **had you been waiting**...?
en:
## The idea: a process that went on up to a past moment
**Past perfect continuous** (had been + -ing) shows that an action **had been going on for some time up to a certain point in the past** (at that point it may have stopped, been interrupted or continued). The length of time is given with **for / since / how long** or implied.
> When Anna arrived, we had been waiting for forty minutes.
> He had been living in Seoul for two years before he learned to read the signs.
This is the same logic as present perfect continuous, shifted into the past.

## Explaining a cause
Most often we use this form to **explain the cause of a state or situation in the past**:
> Her hands were shaking. She had been holding the cold metal for too long.
> The kitchen smelled of onions: somebody had been frying them.
The action may have ended shortly before, but its **traces** are still visible.

## Past perfect continuous or past perfect: process or result
As in the present, **continuous** stresses the process and duration, **simple** the result and quantity.
> She had been painting the fence. (paint on her hands; the fence is not necessarily finished)
> She had painted the fence. (the fence is done)
> By five he had been writing for six hours.
> By five he had written six pages.
State verbs (**know, be, have, like, belong**) stay in the simple form: **I had known him for years.** - ~~I had been knowing him.~~ But with **live, work, teach, study** and for/since both forms are possible with little difference.

## Past continuous: 'at that very moment'
**Past continuous** shows that an action **was in progress at a specific moment** in the past, while **past perfect continuous** shows that it started **earlier** and went on **up to** that moment.
> At eight o'clock I was watching the news. (at that moment)
> At eight o'clock I had been working for three hours. (since five)
> When she called, I was cooking. (the process was going on)
> When she called, I had been cooking for an hour.

## Repetition and negatives
Had been + -ing can also express repeated actions: **He had been missing meetings all spring, so the board was not surprised.** In negatives: **I hadn't been feeling well for days when I finally called the doctor.**

## Reported speech
In reported speech, present perfect continuous shifts to past perfect continuous: 'I've been working all night,' she said. → She said she **had been working** all night.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She was tired. She was working all night.~~ → She was tired. She **had been working** all night.
- ~~I had been knowing him for years.~~ → I **had known** him for years.
- ~~He had been reading three books by June.~~ → He **had read** three books by June.
- ~~How long were you waiting when she came?~~ → How long **had you been waiting**...?
structure:
## Формы
| | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| Past perfect continuous | She had been working. | She hadn't been working. | Had she been working? |
| Past perfect | She had worked. | She hadn't worked. | Had she worked? |
| Past continuous | She was working. | She wasn't working. | Was she working? |

## Формулы
> **had been + V-ing** + for / since + период → длительность до момента в прошлом
> They had been dating for two years when they got engaged.

> past simple (состояние) + **had been + V-ing** (причина)
> His eyes were red. He had been reading all night.

## Сравнительная таблица
| Значение | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Процесс в момент | past continuous | At nine I was reading. |
| Процесс до момента | past perfect continuous | By nine I had been reading for two hours. |
| Результат, количество | past perfect | By nine I had read forty pages. |
| Состояние до момента | past perfect (simple) | I had known her for years. |
| Причина состояния | past perfect continuous | He was dirty; he had been digging. |
| Косвенная речь | past perfect continuous | She said she had been waiting. |

## Типичные модели
| Вопрос | Ответ |
|---|---|
| How long had you been waiting? | I had been waiting for an hour. |
| What had you been doing? | I had been studying. |

exercises.title: Past perfect continuous или past perfect?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в past perfect continuous, past perfect или past continuous.
exercises.example: She was exhausted. She (work) since six. → She had been working since six.

items.text: She was exhausted. She {{had been working|'d been working}} since six that morning.
When Tom finally arrived, we {{had been waiting|'d been waiting}} for nearly two hours.
The ground was wet. It {{had been raining|'d been raining}} all night.
By noon she {{had written|'d written}} four reports.
How long {{had you been studying|had you studied}} Arabic before you moved to Cairo?
He {{had been|'d been}} my neighbour for ten years before I learned his name.
I {{hadn't been sleeping|had not been sleeping|hadn't slept|had not slept}} well for weeks, so I finally saw a doctor.
The children {{were playing}} outside when I got home; they {{had been playing|'d been playing}} since lunch.
Her eyes were red. She {{had been crying|'d been crying}}.

exercises.title: Причина, длительность, результат
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в past perfect continuous или past perfect.

items.text: I {{had known|'d known}} Ravi for years before we became business partners.
By the time the bus came, we {{had been standing|'d been standing}} in the rain for forty minutes.
She {{had read|'d read}} the whole book by midnight.
He {{had been running|'d been running}}, so he was out of breath.
My hands were covered in flour: I {{had been baking|'d been baking}}.
They had been arguing for hours, but they still {{hadn't reached|had not reached}} an agreement.
He {{had been trying|'d been trying}} to quit smoking for years when he finally succeeded.
The manager {{had been|'d been}} in the job only a week when she resigned.

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, который лучше всего подходит по смыслу.

items.q: When I arrived, the others ___ for an hour.
items.why: Длительность до момента в прошлом — **had been waiting**.

items.q: I was soaking wet because I ___ in the rain.
items.why: Причина состояния в прошлом — **had been walking**.

items.q: By the end of the year she ___ twelve countries.
He ___ English for only a month when he passed the exam.
items.why: Длительность до момента в прошлом (when he passed) — **had been studying**.

items.q: I felt guilty. I ___ about the problem months earlier.
The film ___ for ten minutes when the sound failed.
items.why: Фильм шёл уже десять минут до момента отказа звука — **had been running**.

items.q: She was late. She said she ___ for a parking space for twenty minutes.
items.why: Косвенная речь о прошлом: present perfect continuous → **had been looking**.

options: I had been knowing him for years.
I had known him for years.
She had been writing three emails when I called.
She had written three emails when I called.
items.why: Три письма — количество, нужен past perfect simple.

options: He was tired because he had been driving all night.
He was tired because he was driving all night.
How long had you been working there before you resigned?
How long have you been working there before you resigned?
items.why: Рассказ о прошлом: past perfect continuous.

options: The pitch was muddy; it was raining all week.
The pitch was muddy; it had been raining all week.
items.why: Дождь шёл до того, как поле оказалось грязным.

options: They hadn't been speaking to each other for a month when he apologised.
They didn't been speaking to each other for a month when he apologised.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов, используя past perfect continuous или past perfect.

items.prompt: (he / be / very tired / because / he / drive / all night)
answers: He was very tired because he had been driving all night.
He was very tired because he'd been driving all night.

items.prompt: (how long / you / wait / when / the bus / finally / come?)
answers: How long had you been waiting when the bus finally came?

items.prompt: (we / argue / for an hour / when / the manager / walk in)
answers: We had been arguing for an hour when the manager walked in.
We'd been arguing for an hour when the manager walked in.

items.prompt: (I / not / feel / well / for days / when / I / finally / call / the doctor)
answers: I hadn't been feeling well for days when I finally called the doctor.
I had not been feeling well for days when I finally called the doctor.
I hadn't felt well for days when I finally called the doctor.
I had not felt well for days when I finally called the doctor.

items.prompt: (by 2015 / they / live / in Lima / for ten years)
answers: By 2015 they had been living in Lima for ten years.
By 2015, they had been living in Lima for ten years.
By 2015 they'd been living in Lima for ten years.
By 2015, they'd been living in Lima for ten years.
By 2015 they had lived in Lima for ten years.
By 2015, they had lived in Lima for ten years.
By 2015 they'd lived in Lima for ten years.
By 2015, they'd lived in Lima for ten years.
They had been living in Lima for ten years by 2015.
They had lived in Lima for ten years by 2015.

items.prompt: (the printer / break down / three times / that week)
answers: The printer had broken down three times that week.

items.prompt: (he / work / as a journalist / before / he / become / a novelist)
answers: He had been working as a journalist before he became a novelist.
He'd been working as a journalist before he became a novelist.
He had worked as a journalist before he became a novelist.
He'd worked as a journalist before he became a novelist.

exercises.title: Объясните причину
exercises.instruction: Соедините предложения словом because (или добавьте by ... по образцу), используя past perfect continuous.

items.prompt: Her eyes were red. She cried. (because)
answers: Her eyes were red because she had been crying.
Her eyes were red because she'd been crying.

items.prompt: My legs ached. I stood for hours. (because)
answers: My legs ached because I had been standing for hours.
My legs ached because I'd been standing for hours.

items.prompt: The windows were steamy. They cooked all day. (because)
answers: The windows were steamy because they had been cooking all day.
The windows were steamy because they'd been cooking all day.

items.prompt: Dan started jogging in January. It was now April. (By April, ... for three months.)
answers: By April Dan had been jogging for three months.
By April, Dan had been jogging for three months.

items.prompt: I started the job at 9. By noon I ... for three hours. (work)
answers: By noon I had been working for three hours.
By noon I'd been working for three hours.
By noon, I had been working for three hours.
By noon, I'd been working for three hours.

items.prompt: I couldn't fall asleep. I drank coffee all evening. (because)
answers: I couldn't fall asleep because I had been drinking coffee all evening.
I couldn't fall asleep because I'd been drinking coffee all evening.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями на английском, используя past perfect continuous, past perfect и past continuous.

items.prompt: Describe a time when you arrived somewhere and someone had been waiting for you for a long time.
items.sample: When I got to the café, my friend had been waiting for me for forty minutes.

items.prompt: Why were you tired or in a bad mood last time? Use because + had been + -ing.
items.sample: I was tired because I had been working on a presentation until two in the morning.

items.prompt: What were you doing at 9 p.m. yesterday? What had you been doing before that?
items.sample: At nine I was watching a film. Before that I had been cooking and cleaning the kitchen.

items.prompt: Describe how long you had been learning English when you first spoke to a foreigner.
items.sample: I had been learning English for about two years when I first spoke to a tourist.

items.prompt: Write about something you had been trying to do for a long time before you finally managed it.
items.sample: I had been trying to run five kilometres for months before I finally did it last spring.
